notes: A red error strip no longer appears when you tap a tab as the app is going to the background. The tab animation was being aborted by the system, and the abort was reported as a failure — it is not one. The animation now waits until the app is actually on screen, and an abort is handled quietly wherever it lands.

The tap is no longer lost either. If the system cancels the animation before the screen had swapped, the same navigation runs again without it, so the tab you tapped is the tab you get. Once, never twice.
The tab animation itself is unchanged: same slide, same timing, and it still stands aside for Reduce motion and for the app’s own reduce-motion switch.
Nothing else moved — the player, the library, the widget, the glass, the lyrics and the audio graph are exactly as they were.
